exposure: Caesarean section performed by Assistant Medical Officer (AMO)
Caesarean section performed by Medical Doctor (MD)
cohort: 4302 clinical records of C-sections conducted between January 1, 2014 and December 31, 2015 at three secondary and three primary health facilities in Kigoma, Morogoro, Mtwara and Tanga regions, Tanzania.
finding: There was no statistical difference between C-sections performed by AMOs and MDs in terms of maternal and neonatal outcomes.
